_readme: Answers for scripts/migrate-roster-2024.js (--answers 2024_MIGRATION_ANSWERS.json). Keys per character are question ids from the report. 'background' is the 2024 background the character takes (it grants an origin feat). PROPOSED by Claude from each character's recorded skills and notes — edit freely, then re-run. Set "originFeat": "none" for a character to skip the origin feat.
